summary: A one-screen-and-a-bit bento page for Fictional, a five-weight cartoon sans by Jonas Type: a comic-sticker hero that types itself in, coloured cards for styles, a weight slider, a glyph inspector and a starburst BUY NOW. Hidden underneath is a game: every element is 'shootable', with sound effects, a score, unlockable select/text/fire modes and a restore screen.

instances.look: A rounded peach card with 'Fictional' at ~200px in black bold, surrounded by comic stickers: white speech bubbles ('A friendly & quirky typeface', 'with a cartoonesque character'), a red 'KABOOOM' starburst, a yellow 'BANG' starburst, a green 'NEW!' disc, violet 'OUT NOW' and 'scroll down ↓' discs, green '5 WEIGHTS' and red 'FREE TRIAL AVAILABLE' and 'GET IT HERE' tilted labels
instances.ux: On load the name types in letter by letter on an empty peach card, then the stickers pop in one after another; every sticker and letter is a target in the hidden shooting game; in text mode the name and bubbles are editable (max 10 / 28 / 29 characters)
instances.learn: Use comic-book sticker shapes (speech bubble, starburst, label) for the selling points around the name: the tagline copy becomes part of the specimen

reconstruction.layout: Card x=20, y=20, 1400×860, radius ~12px; name centred at ~200px; nine stickers absolutely positioned around it, each rotated −15…+15°: bubbles ~480×70px, starbursts ~300px, discs ~130px, labels ~40px tall
reconstruction.typography: Name ~200px Fictional wght 140 (UltraBold); bubble text ~30px wght 100; sticker text 18–30px caps in wght 100–140; ss01 used on some stickers
reconstruction.behaviour: CSS keyframes ani-intro-lettering (each letter span appears, with a wght change), then ani-intro-speechbubble_1/2, ani-intro-round, ani-intro-label_1/2, ani-intro-shout pop the stickers in with staggered delays (~2.5s total)
reconstruction.content: Taglines and comic shouts: 'A friendly & quirky typeface', 'with a cartoonesque character', 'NEW!', 'OUT NOW', '5 WEIGHTS', 'FREE TRIAL AVAILABLE', 'KABOOOM', 'BANG'
reconstruction.assets: SVG starburst and speech-bubble tail shapes
reconstruction.html: section.intro > h1.editable.shootable[data-max-length=10] > span per letter + div.intro-stickercontainer > div.intro-sticker.intro-sticker--speechbubble|--round|--label|--shout.shootable

instances.variantDefinition: A hidden game layer over the specimen page itself: every element (letters, stickers, glyph cells, buttons) is a target the visitor clicks to shoot away, with sound effects, a score counter, modes unlocked by playing (e.g. text editing, rapid fire) and a restore button that rebuilds the page.
instances.look: Nothing signals the game in the capture: a hidden toolbar (↖ Select mode, T Text mode, F Fire mode, 'restore'), a score counter '0', toast notifications ('Toolbar unlocked!', 'Text mode unlocked!', 'Fire mode unlocked!', 'Congratulations! You shot ’em all!') and an off-screen violet 'r e s t o r e' screen whose letters drop in one by one
instances.ux: Clicking 'shootable' elements blows them away with a boom sound (or a 'blocked' sound), raising the score; progress unlocks a toolbar, then Text mode (edit the name, bubbles, paragraph and CTA within max lengths) and Fire mode; 'restore' plays the full-screen restore animation and rebuilds the page
instances.learn: Turn the specimen into the game board: shooting letters and stickers makes visitors touch every glyph, and unlocking 'text mode' rewards play with a tester

reconstruction.layout: Toolbar of four small square buttons and a score counter, fixed (position unknown, likely a corner); notifications stacked as dismissible pills (×); restore screen is a fixed full-viewport violet overlay with a centred word
reconstruction.typography: Restore word ~115px Fictional wght 100 white, letters spaced apart; toasts ~16px
reconstruction.behaviour: Every .shootable element listens for clicks; hit → explode/remove + audio.boom (assets/sounds/boom.m4a), non-target → audio.blocked; .score increments (scoreanimation keyframes animate its weight); thresholds unlock .toolbar and modes; .editable elements become editable in text mode, limited by data-max-length and resettable from data-original-text; restore → .refreshscreen letters animate in with 0.1s staggered animation-delay
reconstruction.content: Game copy: 'Toolbar unlocked!', 'Text mode unlocked!', 'Fire mode unlocked!', 'Congratulations! You shot ’em all!'
reconstruction.assets: Two sound effects (boom, blocked) from zapsplat.com
reconstruction.html: div.toolbar > button.toolbar-selectmode / .toolbar-textmode / .toolbar-firemode / .toolbar-btn--refresh; div.score; div.notifications > button.notification-*; div.refreshscreen > div.refreshscreen-text > span[style=animation-delay]; 328 .shootable elements; body.body--selectmode
